what: A text has gaps and there is a box of words. You drag the right word into each gap. Some words are not used.
tests: Reading: vocabulary, grammar and understanding of the text.

scoring.note: Pearson's page names no separate traits for this task.

strategy: Read the text once for the general meaning.
Decide the word type for each gap (noun, verb, adjective...).
Fill the easiest gaps first. Remaining words become fewer.
Check that each word fits the grammar and meaning of its sentence.
example_prompt: Bees ____ flowers, which helps plants produce fruit. (pollinate / pollution / visit / visiting)

strong.why: A plural verb is needed after 'Bees', and the meaning fits 'helps plants produce fruit'.

medium.why: Grammar is fine, but 'pollinate' explains why it helps plants; check the meaning of the whole sentence.

weak.why: A noun cannot follow the subject here.

mistakes: Using a word because it appears in the text nearby.
